items.notes: Explains the membership-versus-connection distinction, the GOAWAY last-stream boundary, the ordered drain sequence with unresolved-ID recording, and the same-identity resolution of the ambiguous publish.
Separates the DNS record TTL from connection, membership, admitted-work and retry lifetimes, and specifies the readiness, drain, bounded-tail and observed data-plane conditions before retirement.
Justifies side-effect suppression during replay, atomic view-plus-cursor commit, positional freshness, and the promotion gate before a rebuilt view may serve as current.
Covers the activity crash window and duplicate email, deterministic versioned replay, idempotency-key guarantees, and why coordinator completion is not proof of the external effect.
Treats uncalibrated as a complete declared status, describes the all-assumed contract, and limits the run to conditional, replayable synthetic-workload claims rather than production evidence.
